name: pacing
description: Use better models and still make your weekly Claude plan last. Your best model does the hard work and cheaper models take easier work as subagents; a day-by-day budget decides how much moves down, so the week doesn't run out before the reset. With a status line showing what is left of the budget, a pane beside the chat, four role agents that work in parallel and keep notes per project, and handovers between long sessions.
